author: _TheEpicDirt_
body:
Youtube Application
Minecraft Username: _TheEpicDirt_
Discord ID: TheEpicDirt#1785
In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: I'm the Tech Guy for Team Rocket. I like to edit videos and make art and stuff.
What is your Youtube channel? -
TheEpicDirt and Super W Bros.
What software do you use when recording videos? Do you have experience editing videos?
-For recording I usually use Bandicam, although I am able to record and stream using an Elgato Game Capture HD.
-Yes. I have at least five years of experience filming and editing videos.
Have you ever advertised using YouTube?
-Unless being one of the editors for the "Team Rocket is Ready for Race for Victory II" video counts, no.
Have you ever marketed something using Youtube before?
-I believe I've done a review for Minecraft: WIndows 10 Edition, as well as a reaction to the trailer for Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister location. I also like to think that Let's Plays are advertising for the video game you're playing, as you'll be comentating on the gameplay, graphics, etc. for free.
What changes would you like to see made on the Youtube team?
- Highlight reels from tournaments and maybe some cool advertising videos (like the "Team Rocket is Ready for Race for Victory II" video) would be nice.
How active are you/how is your work ethic?
-I will literally never stop on a project until it's done.
You get to create videos that will be put up on the official YouTube account. You will be able to design, make and/or edit videos that will advertise the server.
Great. Thanks! :)
-TheEpicDirt
Instagram Application
Minecraft Username: _TheEpicDirt_
Discord ID: TheEpicDirt#1785
In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: I'm Team Rocket's tech guy. I like editing videos and making art and stuff.
What is your Instagram account?
-theepicdirt / wooly.z (personal)
Have you ever marketed something using Instagram before?
-Yes. I have advertised video games. I was also the photographer for the photos on the first ever post on the Official Avicus Instagram.
What changes would you like to see made on the Instagram team?
-More posts. As far as I've seen, there have been very few posts on the Official Avicus Instagram to date.
How active are you/how is your work ethic?
-My work ethic is very good. I'm not to active on my own personal Instagram accounts, mostly because I don't have anything to post about. I can guarentee that I will put much more work into the Official Avicus Instagram though. ;)
After a long hiatus, we are finally bringing back our official Instagram account. If you have a passion for advertising on the Instagram platform, this will be perfect for creating a brand for Avicus on the platform.
Hope to be part of the team! :)
-TheEpicDirt
Graphic Team Application
Minecraft Username: _TheEpicDirt_
Discord ID: TheEpicDirt#1785
In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: I'm Team Rocket's tech guy. I like editing videos and making art and stuff.
What program do you use to design in?
-Clip Studio Paint Pro.
If you have past work, please link photos or videos.
-https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCs3_jAS4TfxmJF0usv3q9RA
-https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCD1gWq-ZcR2T47B44ngDdvA
-https://www.instagram.com/theepicdirt/
-https://www.instagram.com/officialavicus/
Have you ever marketed using your designing skills?
-No. I'm hoping to put my skills to good use.
If yes above, please describe what you had to do and the challenges you faced.
What changes would you like to see made on the Graphic Design team?
-Just generally have more options and variety.
How active are you/how is your work ethic?
-My work ethic is very good. I am very active, I draw all the time.
You get to allow your great artistic skills show and help collaborate official Avicus artworks our social media accounts and other various needs.to advertise the server.
Thanks for the opportunity!
-TheEpicDirt
